fields.text: Upload a product still; P-Image Upscale (`pruna-ai/p-image/upscale`) enlarges it to 2 megapixels (size `2`, $0.005). First-click story is a matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio with one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron — this repo has no committed still, so upload that product photo or any catalog plate. This is resolution upscale only, not a relit seamless catalog (use Clean product photo), not a transparent cutout (use Product cutout / BiRefNet V2), and not text-selected isolate (use Text-selected isolate / SAM 3). Inspect native sharpness against the input; Export preview is a local 1024 fit only.

Preserve the exact product shape, materials, markings and the electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron on this matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio. Sharpen fine edges only. Do not restyle, recolor, invent props, or change composition.
